[[File:Volpai.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Tiggs Leo with facial piercings.]]
A '''piercing''' was a [[Ring/Legends|ring]] or other item worn pierced through the skin as a decorative item. [[Myri Antilles]] was given a pair of earrings for her [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] in [[43 ABY]] by her father, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. The set had [[laser scalpel]] cores that were activated with a twist.<ref name="Roll of the Dice">{{InsiderCite|135|Roll of the Dice}}</ref>

[[Bartender/Legends|Bartender]] [[Tiggs Leo/Legends|Tiggs Leo]] had several facial piercings,<ref name="Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> as did the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Haka Hai]].<ref name="DT 8">[[Dark Times 8|''Dark Times'' 8]]</ref>
